summary: @ornikar/rollup-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime zip from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts the bun binary to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and immediately invokes it via execFileSync against a bundled sibling file math_init.js (727 KB, heavily obfuscated). Both setup.mjs and math_init.js exhibit obfuscator.io-style transformations (proxy string objects with _0xNNNN identifiers in setup.mjs, and a rotating string-array construct in math_init.js) despite the wrapper's logic being trivial download-and-exec. The package is advertised as a rollup configuration helper with main createRollupConfig.js, which has no reference to math_init.js; the sibling payload is reachable only through the preinstall dropper chain. Downloading an alternate JavaScript runtime and executing an opaque local blob under it at npm install time bypasses Node-based scanners and lets attacker-controlled bytes run on the installer's machine before any user code is invoked.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
